sources.title: ISO 2575:2021 — Road vehicles — Symbols for controls, indicators and tell-tales
supports: Scope and purpose of standardized vehicle control/indicator/tell-tale symbols
Standard includes information about possible optical tell-tale colours
sources.claim_scope: Standard overview only; does not replace model-specific owner information. Full standard text is not reproduced.

sources.title: Dashboard Symbols & Warning Lights Meaning
supports: ABS warning light may indicate ABS or Brake Assist malfunction
Charging system warning light indicates a charging-system malfunction
EPS warning light indicates an EPS-system malfunction
SRS warning light indicates an SRS airbag-system malfunction
Toyota explicitly advises consulting the vehicle owner's manual; symbol colours vary by vehicle/system
sources.claim_scope: Toyota's general warning-light reference; exact meaning and response remain vehicle-specific.

sources.title: 2024 Corolla Owner's Manual — Warning lights and indicators
supports: Instrument-cluster warning lights and indicators inform the driver about vehicle-system status
The page distinguishes warning lights from indicators and lists charging, MIL, SRS and ABS lights
sources.claim_scope: 2024 Toyota Corolla manual example; not universal across makes/models.

sources.title: 2026 Prius Owner's Manual — If a warning light turns on
supports: MIL may relate to hybrid, electronic engine, electronic throttle or emissions control systems
SRS warning light can concern airbags or seat-belt pretensioners
ABS warning light can concern ABS or brake assist
EPS warning light indicates an EPS malfunction
sources.claim_scope: 2026 Toyota Prius example; system coverage differs by vehicle.

sources.title: Toyota 86 Owner's Manual — Steps to take in an emergency
supports: MIL, SRS, ABS and EPS warning-light examples and model-specific interpretations
sources.claim_scope: Toyota 86 manual example; do not generalize its actions or warning timing.

sources.title: 2025 Kia Owner's Manual — Warning lights (charging system and MIL)
supports: Charging-system warning may concern alternator or electrical charging system
MIL illuminates during the vehicle's start-up check and may remain on for a malfunction; exact interpretation is model-specific
sources.claim_scope: Kia model-specific online owner's manual page; not a universal repair procedure.

sources.title: 2025 Kia Owner's Manual — ABS, EPS and charging warning lights
supports: ABS warning lamp indicates ABS malfunction in the cited model
EPS warning lamp indicates an electric power steering malfunction in the cited model
Charging-system warning lamp may indicate alternator or charging-system malfunction
sources.claim_scope: Kia model-specific owner's manual; actions and display behavior must not be generalized.

sources.title: Atlas 2025 Quick Start Guide — Warning/Indicator Lights
supports: VW distinguishes steady/flashing ESC states and identifies ABS, MIL and airbag/seat-belt tensioner warnings
Warning-light interpretation is tied to the specific vehicle guide

supports: Battery warning light may indicate the 12-volt battery is not charging properly
Warning/indicator lamps may be accompanied by a message or acoustic signal
Owner's Manual remains the detailed vehicle-specific reference
